checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals event-tracking, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals event-tracking; description names the funnel events through confirm, the post-signup revenue event, and the to-confirm mobile mapping.

checks.description: The plan defines the four funnel events page_view, gate_view, submit, confirm with fire conditions.
checks.rule: Body lists page_view, gate_view, submit, confirm, each with a fire condition.

checks.description: The plan adds a post-signup revenue event (purchase or subscription_start) after confirm, mapped to GA4 purchase and Meta Purchase.
checks.rule: Body defines a post-signup revenue event named purchase or subscription_start with a fire condition, and maps it to GA4 purchase and Meta Purchase.

checks.description: An event_id deduplication rule is present for events sent by both Meta Pixel and CAPI.
checks.rule: Body states that an event sent by both the Meta Pixel and the Conversions API must carry one shared event_id so it is not double-counted, and that the event_id is non-identifying. The test plan verifies deduplication.

checks.description: Each event maps to Meta Pixel or CAPI and to GA4 with a destination event name.
checks.rule: Output includes a Pixel or CAPI mapping and a GA4 mapping for the events.

checks.description: Hard rule present: no personal or sensitive data in URL parameters or tracking.
checks.rule: Parameters section and hard rules state non-identifying values only; no email, phone, or name in a URL parameter.

checks.description: Mobile mapping (Apple IAP, Google Play) is flagged as a to-confirm open item, never guessed.
checks.rule: Body marks Apple IAP and Google Play mapping as a to-confirm open item and forbids guessing it.

checks.description: Gate-side wiring blocks on the platform open item; web events are planned regardless.
checks.rule: Body states the gate platform is an open item and gate-side wiring blocks until it is confirmed.

checks.description: A test plan requires each event to fire once, in order, before go-live.
checks.rule: Body specifies an operational test where each event fires once in order in a test session before the human gate.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash character, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.

checks.description: The output populates the event_plan field of the conversion-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the event_plan field of the conversion-package.
